scope: Native LS027B7DH01 tail only; no extension cable and no PCB

frame.datum: active area center; positive Z toward viewer

tail_exit_evidence: Sharp p26 stack: front target -1.4 minus front polarizer0.23 and glass0.6; assembly interpretation

free_tail_length_mm.qualification: Layout estimate from drawing proportions only; not a toleranced Sharp overall-length dimension. Measure actual glass-edge-to-tip before fixing board-side connector location.

flex_envelope_thickness_mm.qualification: Manufacturer stiffened-tail nominal thickness used conservatively for entire route; not measured bare flex thickness

bend.direction: behind panel, never toward front polarizer

negative_path_clearance.implementation: annular half-cylinder and straight segments cut from housing and retainer; not a fake FPC body

connector.cad_identity_scope: same-family KiCad dimensional reference; (55) suffix not certified by STEP
connector.contact_direction: native back-side contacts become +Z after fold; inverted bottom-contact connector faces them, board datum above connector
connector.pin1_note: 180deg rotation about local Y reverses X; final PCB must map Sharp back-view pin1 against connector pin1, never copy a straight-tail footprint blindly

service.assembly: Connect with pod removed and inverted, after isolating power and removing Pi if access requires it; engage the stiffener fully and close latch before pod installation. Hold the panel/frame, never hang it by its tail.
service.strain_relief: Non-contact U guard around fold; glass has its own retainer and connector must be anchored on future board. Guard does not clamp copper or glass bond.

remaining_checks: Actual free tail length and tolerances, connector entry/stop datum and pin1 on physical parts
Compliant support material, thickness stack and image uniformity under fastening
Bind connector target to an actual supported board in a later PCB-authorized query
